name: pdk-opennext-tag-revalidation-vs-inflight-render
instr:
# Cross-instance on-demand tag coherence

Build cross-instance on-demand cache coherence for published content: after `revalidateTag` acknowledges an update, visitors on any OpenNext instance see fresh pages and tagged fetch results. A path soft tag passed to `revalidateTag` has the same guarantee for the tagged page. Shared S3 incremental and DynamoDB tag caches need to handle overlapping renders without ordering writes by wall-clock time.

## What we need

- After on-demand revalidation completes, both instances reject the old tagged page and fetch entry; a subsequent render becomes visible from either instance.
- A render that began reading data before revalidation cannot overwrite a newer S3 entry or be served fresh after acknowledgement, even when its source response or its S3 write arrives later. The S3 incremental cache keeps each entry's current payload at its existing `<build id>/<key>.cache` object (here `sd-build/<key>.cache`).
- Clock skew of five seconds between instances does not change these guarantees. Revalidation ordering cannot depend on comparing wall-clock times.
- Twenty simultaneous requests after revalidation regenerate no more than once per instance, return fresh content, and keep returning fresh content thereafter.
- Entries written without generation metadata by the previous version remain readable until revalidated. Revalidating one tag does not invalidate unrelated entries.
